#### AddDataverseConnectionPool

```text
public static Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection AddDataverseConnectionPool(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services, Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration.IConfiguration configuration, System.String environment = default, System.String sectionName = "Dataverse")
```

Adds Dataverse connection pooling services from configuration.

- Parameter `services`: The service collection.
- Parameter `configuration`: The configuration root.
- Parameter `environment`: Optional environment name. When specified, uses the connections from that named environment (Environments dictionary) instead of root-level Connections. When not specified but Environments are defined, uses DefaultEnvironment or the first environment.
- Parameter `sectionName`: The configuration section name. Default: &quot;Dataverse&quot;

Returns: The service collection for chaining.

Remarks: Environment Resolution Order: Explicit environment parameter (highest priority) DefaultEnvironment from configuration First environment if Environments are defined Root-level Connections (fallback) Property Inheritance: Connections inherit Url and TenantId from their environment, which inherits from root. Connection-level settings override environment-level, which override root-level.

#### RegisterDataverseServices

```text
public static Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection RegisterDataverseServices(Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.IServiceCollection services)
```

Registers core Dataverse services including throttle tracking and pool-consuming services. Called by both library registration and CLI ProfileServiceFactory.

- Parameter `services`: The service collection.

Returns: The service collection for chaining.

Remarks: This method exists to prevent DI registration divergence between library and CLI. When adding a new service that should be available in CLI, add it here. Note: PPDS.Dataverse.Pooling.IDataverseConnectionPool is NOT registered here because the library and CLI use different construction patterns: Library: Direct type registration from configuration CLI: Factory delegate with IConnectionSource[] from auth profiles
